tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The slide ground. Every slide is white; cover and section slides put veil over the photo instead.

tokens.name: surface-code
tokens.usage: Chip behind inline code (paths, config keys) set in code-inline with ink-code.

tokens.name: surface-carbon
tokens.usage: Padding ground of a Carbon code image (20px around the monokai window); the only place a near-white tint touches the slide.

tokens.name: surface-monokai
tokens.usage: The monokai editor window inside a Carbon code image; Carbon paints it, never a slide shape. Code images are the one dark block a slide may carry.

tokens.name: surface-head
tokens.usage: Header row and reference (baseline) row of a results table; table text in ink on it.

tokens.name: surface-head-blue
tokens.usage: Bold header row of a settings or literature table (one row per paper or model); ink on it. Never together with surface-head in one table.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Titles, body, leads, prose, table text, rules and the table grid, on surface (21:1) and on every tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Cover and section subtitle over veil, and the numbered notes under a table. 7:1 on surface; about 4.1:1 where the photo is black under the veil, so never below 14pt bold there.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tentative side remarks inside a discussion page ('I'll check later'). Kept from the decks: 2.7:1 on surface fails 4.5:1; use ink-muted for anything that must be read.

tokens.name: ink-code
tokens.usage: Inline code text on surface-code (12:1).

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: The topic line under every slide title, and the title of a TODO page; nothing else. On surface only (4.6:1).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Hyperlinks in footnotes, reference lists and reading pages, always underlined, on surface (9.4:1).

tokens.name: code-green
tokens.usage: Special tokens (<OBJxxx>) and dataset paths inside code blocks and table cells, on surface (5.0:1).

tokens.name: code-blue
tokens.usage: The system prompt's own words in a prompt block, on surface (6.6:1).

tokens.name: code-orange
tokens.usage: Program source (a HumanEval prompt, a model's code response) in code blocks, on surface (4.6:1).

tokens.name: run-blue
tokens.usage: Bold 12pt run names (vicuna_7b_voxel_stage2_..._2-65). Kept from the decks: 2.7:1 on surface fails 4.5:1, so prefer code-blue on new slides.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: The outline rectangle that circles a region of a figure (4.0:1 on surface passes the 3:1 floor for marks). Also the decks' red bold text, which fails 4.5:1: use alert-deep for text.

tokens.name: alert-deep
tokens.usage: Bold urgent notes, blockers and the key formula of a discussion page, on surface (5.9:1); heavier outlines.

tokens.name: mark-orange
tokens.usage: Highlight behind a run-ID callout (⤷ 2-42) in body and footnote text; ink on it.

tokens.name: mark-blue
tokens.usage: Highlight behind chat-template control tokens (<|im_start|>) in prompt blocks; ink on it.

tokens.name: mark-yellow
tokens.usage: Highlight behind a work-in-progress label; ink on it.

tokens.name: band-blue
tokens.usage: Results-table rows of the first comparison group (this week's runs, ours); whole rows, ink on it.

tokens.name: band-orange
tokens.usage: Results-table rows of the second comparison group (baselines, other proposers); whole rows, ink on it. Blue and orange, never red and green.

tokens.name: overlay-peach
tokens.usage: 50% peach rectangle laid over part of a screenshot or image-rendered table to point at a row or region.

tokens.name: overlay-pink
tokens.usage: 50% pink rectangle over the negative or problem region of a figure, beside overlay-peach.

tokens.name: veil
tokens.usage: 78% white sheet over the cover photo on cover and section slides; ink and ink-muted text sit on it.

tokens.name: fig-llm
tokens.usage: draw.io fill of the LLM slab (Qwen's VL attentions, the backbone); no stroke, rounded; label in fig-llm-label.

tokens.name: fig-llm-label
tokens.usage: Font colour of the LLM slab's label (Times New Roman 18) on fig-llm; 4.5:1.

tokens.name: fig-decoder
tokens.usage: draw.io fill of the mask decoder (Mask3D decoder, SAM decoder); no stroke, rounded, label in ink.

tokens.name: fig-head
tokens.usage: draw.io fill of small heads and post-processing (Query MLP, Split); stroke fig-head-line.

tokens.name: fig-head-line
tokens.usage: Stroke of fig-head boxes.

tokens.name: fig-text-decoder
tokens.usage: draw.io fill of the text decoder and other output heads; stroke fig-text-decoder-line.

tokens.name: fig-text-decoder-line
tokens.usage: Stroke of fig-text-decoder boxes.

tokens.name: fig-module
tokens.usage: draw.io fill of external or frozen modules (CLIP, SAM encoder, Sonata, fine-cell embedding, masked cross-attention, MLP) and, at 35% opacity, the dashed stage frame; stroke fig-module-line.

tokens.name: fig-module-line
tokens.usage: Stroke of fig-module boxes and of the dashed stage frame.

tokens.name: fig-layer
tokens.usage: draw.io fill of a repeated layer frame (Decoder Layer 1..3); dashed stroke fig-layer-line, italic Times New Roman 16 label at the top-left.

tokens.name: fig-layer-line
tokens.usage: Dashed stroke of fig-layer frames.

tokens.name: fig-projector
tokens.usage: draw.io fill of projectors and readouts between modules; stroke fig-projector-line.

tokens.name: fig-projector-line
tokens.usage: Stroke of fig-projector boxes.

tokens.name: fig-frozen
tokens.usage: draw.io fill of a frozen LoRA or weight badge (Times New Roman 11 in fig-frozen-text) with ❄️ beside it; stroke fig-frozen-line.

tokens.name: fig-frozen-line
tokens.usage: Stroke of fig-frozen badges.

tokens.name: fig-frozen-text
tokens.usage: Label colour on fig-frozen badges (5.4:1).

tokens.name: fig-trainable
tokens.usage: draw.io fill of a trainable LoRA badge (🔥 beside it) and of special-token chips (<OBJxxx>, <SEG>, W_Q); stroke fig-trainable-line, label in ink.

tokens.name: fig-trainable-line
tokens.usage: Stroke of fig-trainable badges and chips.

tokens.name: fig-state
tokens.usage: draw.io fill of hidden-state and scene-token cells (16px rounded squares in a white stack with an ink stroke); stroke fig-state-line.

tokens.name: fig-state-line
tokens.usage: Stroke of fig-state cells.

tokens.name: fig-obj
tokens.usage: draw.io fill of question and object tokens ('obj' cells) in a token stack; stroke fig-obj-line.

tokens.name: fig-obj-line
tokens.usage: Stroke of fig-obj cells.

tokens.name: fig-query
tokens.usage: draw.io fill of decoder queries (q0..q3, LOC) with a white label; stroke fig-query-line.

tokens.name: fig-query-line
tokens.usage: Stroke of fig-query cells.

tokens.name: fig-lat
tokens.usage: draw.io fill of latent or <LAT> tokens in a stack; stroke fig-stroke.

tokens.name: fig-grid
tokens.usage: draw.io fill of the empty cells of a scene or voxel grid (16px squares); stroke fig-grid-line.

tokens.name: fig-grid-line
tokens.usage: Stroke of fig-grid cells.

tokens.name: fig-voxel-1
tokens.usage: Occupied voxel or object instance in a scene grid (stroke fig-stroke); first of eight.

tokens.name: fig-voxel-2
tokens.usage: Second instance colour in a scene grid.

tokens.name: fig-voxel-3
tokens.usage: Third instance colour in a scene grid.

tokens.name: fig-voxel-4
tokens.usage: Fourth instance colour in a scene grid.

tokens.name: fig-voxel-5
tokens.usage: Fifth instance colour in a scene grid.

tokens.name: fig-voxel-6
tokens.usage: Sixth instance colour in a scene grid.

tokens.name: fig-voxel-7
tokens.usage: Seventh instance colour in a scene grid.

tokens.name: fig-voxel-8
tokens.usage: Eighth instance colour in a scene grid.

tokens.name: fig-note
tokens.usage: draw.io fill of a notes or loss box (math in Times New Roman); stroke fig-note-line, dashed for an aside.

tokens.name: fig-note-line
tokens.usage: Stroke of fig-note boxes.

tokens.name: fig-stroke
tokens.usage: Stroke of coloured voxels and lat tokens, and the colour of secondary diagram labels (loss terms).

tokens.name: fig-attn-red
tokens.usage: Dashed red arrows and thin frames for attention masks and 'Bi-direction Attn' annotations in diagrams.

tokens.name: fig-dot-blue
tokens.usage: Dotted oval-ended link from a query to its mask (first query).

tokens.name: fig-dot-orange
tokens.usage: Dotted oval-ended link from a query to its mask (second query).

tokens.name: fig-dot-red
tokens.usage: Dotted oval-ended link from a query to its mask (third query).

groups.name: Titles
groups.note: Arial, the heading face, on the title tier only: cover title, slide title, topic, cover subtitle and the centred line of a plain divider. Sizes are PowerPoint points x 4/3.

styles.name: cover-title
styles.usage: 26pt bold. Cover and photo section slide titles, in ink over veil; vertically centred in its box.

styles.name: slide-title
styles.usage: 22pt regular, never bold. The category word at the top of every content slide, and the centred text of a plain divider.

styles.name: topic
styles.sample: Category C: LLM backbone as its own proposer
styles.usage: 12.5pt in amber. The one-line topic under the title: what this slide is about, in sentence case.

styles.name: cover-subtitle
styles.usage: 14pt bold Arial in ink-muted: project name on one line, the date on the next.

groups.name: Slide text
groups.note: Times New Roman, the body face: every word on a slide that is not a title or typed code. The floor on a slide is 8pt.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Will KV cache benefit downstream tasks?
styles.usage: 12pt serif. One or two sentences directly under the rule: the question or the claim of the slide.

styles.name: lead-strong
styles.usage: Bold runs inside lead and prose for the one term the slide turns on.

styles.name: prose
styles.sample: Helpfulness: the reasoning model should generate z = RM(P) such that delta is maximised.
styles.usage: 13pt serif. The running text of a discussion page and the 'Prompt:' / 'Response:' labels of a code page; bold terms in lead-strong, the key formula bold in alert-deep.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: - LaDiR: (4, 512) per reasoning step in paper, but (4, 128) in code *1
styles.usage: 12pt serif. Bullet lists, notes blocks and free text; a bold run marks the claim, *1 markers point at footnotes.

styles.name: run-label
styles.usage: 11.5pt serif run ID placed just above the top-left corner of a figure or screenshot.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: *1 Proposal should be scene-shared, so KV cache reuse here might not be the main proposal.
styles.usage: 8pt serif. Footnotes, references, figure captions and the numbered notes under a table (those in ink-muted); the smallest text allowed on a slide.

styles.name: table
styles.usage: 9pt serif, centred. Results tables; the header row is bold.

styles.name: table-dense
styles.usage: 8pt serif. Settings and literature tables, and results tables wider than ten columns.

styles.name: slide-number
styles.usage: 12pt serif, centred in the bottom-right box on every slide but the cover.

groups.name: Code
groups.note: Courier New. Roboto Mono in the June-August decks is retired.

styles.name: code
styles.sample: def has_close_elements(numbers: List[float], threshold: float) -> bool:
styles.usage: 10pt. Prompt templates and config blocks in ink; program source in code-orange.

styles.name: code-role
styles.usage: Bold role label (System:, User:, Assistant:) at the start of a prompt-block line.

styles.name: code-inline
styles.usage: 8pt in ink-code on a surface-code chip, inline in body or table text.

groups.name: Rendered figures
groups.note: Set outside the slide and placed as pictures; sizes are what the renderer uses, not slide points.

styles.name: code-figure
styles.usage: Carbon image text: Hack 14px, monokai, line numbers on; exported at 2x and placed so one line is about the height of 12pt body text.

styles.name: equation
styles.usage: LaTeX standalone at 10pt Computer Modern, rendered at 400dpi; placed at px/400 in for 1:1 with 12pt body, up to 1.5x on an equation-only slide.

styles.name: pseudocode
styles.usage: algorithm2e (ruled, line-numbered, no semicolons) at 10pt, rendered at 400dpi and placed like equation.

spacing.note: Slide inches at 96px per inch: the decks' own insets and gutters.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: 0.04in. Text inset of the slide-number box; the title and topic boxes have no inset.

tokens.name: inset-body
tokens.usage: 0.075in. Text inset of the notes block and the prose block under the rule.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: 0.1in. Default text-box inset; table cell padding; lead, column and footnote insets.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: 0.25in. Gutter between figures, tables or columns placed side by side.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: 0.33in. Left and right slide margin; the x of title, topic and lead.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: 0.5in. Gap between stacked blocks; bullet indent per level.

radius.note: Square on the slide; rounded only inside drawn figures.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Every slide shape: text boxes, tables, overlays, outlines, pictures.

tokens.name: radius-fig
tokens.usage: draw.io rounded=1 on every box, badge, cell and frame of an architecture diagram; grid cells alone stay square.

stroke.note: Line weights in PowerPoint points, as px at 96/in.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: 1pt in ink: the rule under the header and a body rule that splits a page in two.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 0.75pt in ink: every table grid line.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: 1.5pt in alert: the rectangle that circles a region of a figure.

tokens.name: outline-heavy
tokens.usage: 2.25pt: the same outline on a busy screenshot.

layout.note: Anchors of the 960 x 540 slide (10in x 5.625in), px from the top-left; 96px = 1in.

tokens.name: slide-w
tokens.usage: Slide width, 10in.

tokens.name: slide-h
tokens.usage: Slide height, 5.625in.

tokens.name: header-left
tokens.usage: 0.40in. Left edge of the title, topic and rule; the lead, notes and body blocks stay at space-4 (0.33in).

tokens.name: title-top
tokens.usage: 0.20in. Top of the slide-title box (883 x 43px, at header-left, no inset).

tokens.name: topic-top
tokens.usage: 0.63in. Top of the topic box (883 x 29px, at header-left, no inset).

tokens.name: rule-top
tokens.usage: 1.00in. The 1pt rule, from x=38px to x=921px.

tokens.name: lead-top
tokens.usage: 1.02in. Top of the lead, notes or prose block; one line is 38px tall, two lines 58px.

tokens.name: body-top
tokens.usage: 1.55in. Top of figures, tables and text blocks under a lead; 98px when there is no lead.

tokens.name: body-bottom
tokens.usage: 5.20in. Nothing but the footnote and the slide number below this.

tokens.name: table-top
tokens.usage: 1.14in. Top of a table that has no lead above it, at x=54px.

tokens.name: column-w
tokens.usage: 4.55in. Width of each of two side-by-side columns; the second starts at column-2-left.

tokens.name: column-2-left
tokens.usage: 5.12in. Left edge of the second column (space-3 after the first).

tokens.name: divider-top
tokens.usage: 2.57in. Top of the centred slide-title box on a plain divider slide.

tokens.name: foot-top
tokens.usage: 0.24in from the bottom. Top of the footnote box (height 37px); its left edge is x=0 so the text starts at the margin after its inset.

tokens.name: number-left
tokens.usage: 9.31in. Left of the slide-number box (85 x 29px) at top 507px.
